events.title: Uncharted 1: Drake's Fortune is released
events.description: Uncharted 1 is released to the public.

events.title: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves is released
events.description: Uncharted 2 is released to the public. Bob Rafei, Erick Pangilinan and Toby Tobler left the studio after the release of Uncharted 1.

events.title: Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception is released
events.description: Uncharted 3 is released to the public. Bruce Straley, Dan Liebgold, Rob Adams, Judd Simantov and Rich Diamant left the studio after the release of Uncharted 2.

events.title: Uncharted: Golden Abyss is released for the PlayStation Vita.
events.description: Uncharted: Golden Abyss is released to the public for the PlayStation Vita. It was made by a different studio (Bend studio) with Amy Hennig, Game Director and Designer, as a Story Consultant.

events.title: Uncharted: Fight for Fortune is released for the PlayStation Vita.
events.description: Uncharted: Fight for Fortune is released to the public for the PlayStation Vita. It was made by a different studio (Bend studio) with Amy Hennig, Game Director and Designer, as a Story Consultant.

events.title: Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection is released.
events.description: Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection is a remastered collection of Drake's Fortune, Among Thieves and Drake's Deception. It was released to the public for the PlayStation 4.

events.title: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End is released
events.description: Uncharted 4 is released to the public. Amy Hennig, Richard Lemarchand, Pal-Kristian Engstad,Greg Edmonson, Bruce Swanson and Gordon Hunt left the studio after the release of Uncharted 3.

events.title: Uncharted: Fortune hunter is released
events.description: Uncharted: Fortune hunter is released to the public for mobile devices. It was made by a different studio (Playstation Mobile Inc.) with input from the Uncharted team at Naughty Dog.

events.title: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy is released
events.description: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy is released to the public. Jeremy Lai-Yates and Mike Hatfield left the studio after the relase of Uncharted 4.

events.title: Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection is released.
events.description: Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection is a remastered collection of Uncharted 4 and Uncharted: The Lost Legacy. It was released to the public for the PlayStation 5 and Windows by Naughty Dog and Iron Galaxy studios.
